title: 第17章：刚下山的小师妹

胡九郎无奈摇头，语气带着几分宠溺。

“你刚下山，一路奔波，本就劳累，该好好歇息。我常年在卦铺守夜，打地铺早已习惯，再说，你一个姑娘家，守外间我也不放心。就这么定了。”

说着，他便转身抱出一床旧被褥，铺在堂屋的八仙桌旁，又拿出一张黄符，轻轻贴在门框上，低声念了句咒语，符纸便隐入木中，不见踪影。

“这是护宅符，夜里有它在，寻常邪祟近不了身。”

范梦雪看着他熟练的动作，心里又暖又过意不去，默默走进里屋，将自己随身带的一个锦盒拿了出来，递到胡九郎面前。

“师兄，这是我下山时师父给我的清心玉露，睡前喝一口，能安神助眠，还能滋养灵气，你拿着吧。”

胡九郎推辞不过，接过锦盒，指尖触到锦盒的微凉，嘴角扬起一抹浅笑。

“多谢师妹。时候不早了，你快去歇息吧，我守在这里便好。”

范梦雪点点头，又反复叮嘱了几句“师兄要是冷就喊我”“有动静记得叫醒我”，才恋恋不舍地走进里屋，轻轻带上了房门。

夜里格外安静，只有窗外偶尔传来几声夜鸟的啼鸣，卦铺里静得能听到彼此的呼吸声。胡九郎躺在地铺之上，本想借着清心玉露梳理一下桃源古镇的线索，可不知怎的，脑海里总浮现出杨童的模样，辗转反侧，一时竟难以入眠。

就在他快要睡着时，里屋忽然传来“咚”的一声轻响，紧接着便是范梦雪低低的惊呼，带着几分慌乱。

胡九郎瞬间清醒，猛地起身，快步走到房门口，本想推门而入，却又迟疑了一下，随后轻轻敲门。

“师妹，怎么了？出什么事了？”

房门“吱呀”一声被拉开，范梦雪探出头来，头发有些凌乱，脸颊通红，眼神里满是窘迫，手指还紧紧攥着衣角。

“没、没什么师兄，就是……就是我不小心从床上掉了下来，吓了一跳。”

胡九郎看着她泛红的脚踝，眉头微微一皱，伸手轻轻拉过她的手腕，借着堂屋的油灯，仔细看了看。

“都肿了，还说没什么。我忘了告诉你，这张床确实狭小了一点……”

范梦雪不好意思地低下头，声音细若蚊蚋。

“嗯……在山上时，我睡的是石床，铺着干草，比这个大太多，夜里翻身，不小心就掉下来了。我不是娇气，就是……有点不适应。”

Chapter 17: The little junior sister who just came down the mountain - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Coming Down the Mountain"

Hu Jiulang shook his head helplessly, his tone a bit doting.

"You have just come down from the mountain and have been running all the way. You are already tired and you should have a good rest. I have been keeping vigil at Gua Pu all year round and I am used to laying a bunk on the floor. Besides, I don't trust you to guard the outer room of a girl's house. That's it."

With that said, he turned around and took out an old quilt, spread it next to the Eight Immortals table in the main room, took out a yellow talisman, gently pasted it on the door frame, whispered a spell, and the talisman disappeared into the wood.

"This is a house-protecting talisman. With it at night, ordinary evil spirits cannot get close to you."

Seeing his skillful movements, Fan Mengxue felt warm and regretful in her heart. She silently walked into the back room, took out a brocade box she had brought with her, and handed it to Hu Jiulang.

"Senior brother, this is the Qingxin Jade Dew that Master gave me when I came down the mountain. Take a sip before going to bed. It can calm the mind and help you sleep, and it can also nourish your spiritual energy. Take it."

Hu Jiulang couldn't refuse, and took the brocade box. His fingertips felt the coolness of the brocade box, and he raised a slight smile at the corner of his mouth.

"Thank you, junior sister. It's getting late. You should go and have a rest. I'll just stay here."

Fan Mengxue nodded, and repeated a few words, "Senior brother, call me if you feel cold" and "Remember to wake me up if there is any movement" before reluctantly walking into the back room and gently closing the door.

It was extremely quiet at night, except for the occasional chirping of night birds outside the window. The Gua Pu was so quiet that one could hear each other's breathing.Hu Jiulang was lying on the floor. He wanted to use Qingxin Jade Dew to sort out clues about Taoyuan Ancient Town, but somehow, Yang Tong's appearance always appeared in his mind. He tossed and turned and found it difficult to fall asleep for a while.

Just when he was about to fall asleep, a soft "thunk" sound suddenly came from the back room, followed by Fan Mengxue's low exclamation, a bit panicked.

Hu Jiulang woke up instantly, stood up suddenly, and walked quickly to the door of the room. He wanted to push the door open, but hesitated for a moment, and then knocked gently.

"Junior sister, what's wrong? What happened?"

The door opened with a creak, and Fan Mengxue stuck her head out. Her hair was a little messy, her cheeks were red, her eyes were full of embarrassment, and her fingers were still tightly holding the corners of her clothes.

"No, it's nothing, senior brother, it's just... I accidentally fell off the bed and was startled."

Hu Jiulang looked at her red ankle, frowned slightly, reached out and gently pulled her wrist, and took a closer look by the oil lamp in the main room.

"It's all swollen, but they said it's nothing. I forgot to tell you, this bed is indeed a little small..."

Fan Mengxue lowered her head in embarrassment, her voice as thin as a gnat.

"Well... when I was in the mountains, I slept on a stone bed covered with hay, which was much bigger than this. I rolled over at night and accidentally fell off. I'm either squeamish, or... I'm a little uncomfortable with it."
